layers.process: Chingaza National Natural Park: tours require a guide, hired from an agency authorised for the park. Present the printed payment slip and an accident and risk insurance policy at the authorised entry points together with the guide. Only one sector can be visited per day. There is no public transport; arrival is by private vehicle.
Book at least three days ahead through the park's form (active Monday to Friday, office hours); payment needs an approved booking. Entry 7 am to 11 am, exit by 4 pm.

zone-requirements.note: Chingaza only. Older pages gave different lead times, group sizes and trail caps; fees not recorded.
